scripts.setup: npm run build -w @ai-runtime/contracts && npm run db:generate && node scripts/setup-local.mjs
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @ai-runtime/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run build -w @ai-runtime/api && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run architecture:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run contracts:check && npm run build && npm run docs:check
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts config tests playwright.config.ts prisma.config.ts
scripts.typecheck:tests: tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
